name_reason: Fully convention-compliant: data_fd2_ prefix, battle domain (teleport-spell scratch consumed by the battle spell-0x17 worker), descriptor teleport_dest_world_x reflects both purpose (teleport destination tile) and the value semantics (world X coordinate). No Ghidra address residue. 0x17 is the spell ID and lives only in the related worker fn name, not here.
purpose: Scratch dword holding the teleport-spell destination tile world X coordinate (paired with _y @ 0x51CFD); set from the cursor when the player picks a destination, read by fd2_cast_spell_17_complex to pan/warp to that tile.
logic_summary: Both teleport entry paths (fd2_item_command_menu_dispatch USE-spellbook branch @ 0x1BE06, and fd2_spell_selection_menu_main teleport branch @ 0x1D250) write teleport_dest_world_x/y = cursor_world_x/y immediately after the player confirms the destination tile. fd2_cast_spell_17_complex (spell_id 0x17 = teleport) then reads x/y three times (@ 0x22215/0x22229/0x22235) to pan the cursor to the destination and run the dual warp/teleport animation there. The write-before-read invariant holds in every flow, so the 0x12 image byte is dead.
element_semantics: Single dword = destination tile X in battle world-tile coordinates (same coordinate space as cursor_world_x @ 0x53AB1). Paired with data_fd2_battle_teleport_dest_world_y @ 0x51CFD for the full (x,y) destination.
